source_contract_bug: transport.mjs putImmutable publishes a previously single-linked complete staging file with fs.link; target immediately has nlink=2 until finally fs.rm removes staging.
installed_records.rs read_bytes rejects nlink != 1 before parsing JSON.
installed_streaming.rs clients reads any existing inbox target immediately and propagates Invalid without a publication-state distinction or retry.
Thus a conforming publisher has a visible state which its actual concurrent strict reader rejects. Rust write_raw has the same link-before-unlink transition, with a synchronous shorter window.
incident.causality_limit: Failure-time inbox bytes, inode/link count and peer role/read-vs-validate branch were not captured. The source race fits the event, but available records do not prove it caused this hosted incident. No assertion of historical root cause is warranted.
incident.retained_binding_summary: All three retained clients have six ordered complete exit-zero pairs and matching context/maps; Linux servers retain six receipts each, Mac server retains zero receipts and incomplete flag. Mac diagnostic four records equal normal records.
